requirements.statement: A user can sign in securely so their task list is private to them and available whenever they return

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is redirected to sign in before seeing any tasks
After signing in, the user is returned to the app with access to their own task list
A signed-in user's session persists across a page reload without re-authenticating
One user cannot view or affect another user's tasks

requirements.statement: A user can create a new task with a title

criteria.must: Submitting a title creates a new task visible in the user's list
Submitting an empty title is rejected and no task is created

requirements.statement: A user can set an optional due date on a task

criteria.must: A task can be created with a due date and the due date is saved
A task can be created with no due date

requirements.statement: A user can view their list of tasks

criteria.must: The task list shows every task the user has created

requirements.statement: Overdue tasks are visually highlighted in the user's list

criteria.must: A task whose due date is in the past and is not completed is visually marked as overdue in the list
A completed task past its due date is not marked as overdue

requirements.statement: A user can mark a task as complete

criteria.must: Marking a task complete updates its status in the list
A completed task can be distinguished from active tasks in the list view

requirements.statement: A user can edit a task's title or due date

criteria.must: Editing a task's title saves the new title and it is reflected in the list
Editing a task's due date saves the new due date and it is reflected in the list

requirements.statement: A user can delete a task

criteria.must: Deleting a task removes it from the user's list

requirements.statement: A user can sort or filter their tasks, e.g. by due date or completed vs. incomplete

criteria.must: The list can be sorted by due date
The list can be filtered to show only completed tasks
The list can be filtered to show only incomplete (active) tasks
